dex.entry: The apex blizzard-wasp: a slender, blade-like creature that moves through lightning-charged blizzards with total ease, delivering shots of frozen plasma that combine electric and ice damage. Beautiful, lethal, and utterly cold — the sky's version of a thrown spear.

art.silhouette: Long aerodynamic wasp silhouette, pale near-white with deep azure markings, a pair of blade-like crystal wings, four foreleg-lances each tipped with frozen lightning; cold elegance at 64px.
